R48 R49 the case file carries the passage statements only inside the signed document: no extra file, its format and kinds unchanged

R51 the case file carries each extract in the signed document only: no segment byte, no file and nothing in unheld, even for a row signed included; ordinary documents travel whole
R52 a subject changed after publication answers one dated line by key, named only by what the caller hands in; the edition's bytes are unchanged
R53 publishedcase answers every evidence row with name, locator and fingerprint; the group's public name is read with no credential
